items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Interviewer asks 'Did you know Charlie?' and Interviewee responds 'He played with all of us.' implying the interviewee was not part of that specific group or interaction, but acknowledges his reputation ('He was the best').

ctx.x: Where did he die? The clarinet play, is that the one that went up north or stayed here?

Oh, that fellow, that fellow was a famous musician. Was he from a musical family, or? He from, he from, he didn't have much, much kin, folks there, but he was a great, great, great saxophone and clarinet. Uh, yeah, but I'm trying to think of what he did, no. Could he read much, or? Could he? Ha! Sight reader. A man could read. If he hear a number playin, and he had a shirt with a cuff on it, he, he, he, he'd ride it all right, right on his cuff. Was he as good as Bichet, or T.O., or any of those people? Well,…
Did you know Charlie? He played with all of us. Hmm? He played with all of us. Yeah. Uh huh. What about Charlie Galloway? Did you know him? Charlie Galloway, I worked with, uh,
